panels.title: The untended lantern
keyPoses: Wide valley vista at dusk. Rows of small lantern dots along the hollow; the near hill-road lantern burns low, unattended. Nia's hill silhouette at frame right, head bent over her sounding ribbons instead of the wick. Slow push in.

panels.title: The hillside extinguishing
keyPoses: Nia on the hilltop, cloak lifting in gusts. A cross-gust takes the low flame sideways off the wick; the lantern goes dark against the wind. She grabs too late. Medium shot, gentle pan following the smoke.

panels.title: Sparks that will not catch
keyPoses: Close on Nia's charcoal wind-chart beside the dead lantern: swirling arrows that all bent away from the hill road, warnings she never read. Her blackened hand tries a spark-striker, fails, tries again. Match-cut framing to her eyes.

panels.title: Down to Yara
keyPoses: Night falls fast. Two more lanterns gutter out along the hollow road in a visual beat, one, then another. Nia runs downhill toward grandmother's house with the dead lantern clutched to her chest, lantern-light shrinking behind her.

panels.title: What the valley is owed
keyPoses: Inside Yara's lamplit house: walls of charts, a cold hearth, the old keeper listening without moving. Nia sets the dead lantern down between them like an accusation against herself.

panels.title: The keeper's lantern
keyPoses: Close on Yara's large steady hands kindling the keeper's lantern from the hearth coal, then holding it out. Nia's small hands hover, pull back, then close around the handle. The flame leans but holds.

panels.title: Two marks on the chart
keyPoses: The forbidden chart unrolled: the gorge, the washed-out bridge marked in Yara's mother's hand, the cliff path, and the station circle where two small figures wait. Yara's finger traces the path Nia must walk with children in tow.

panels.title: Threshold farewell
keyPoses: Threshold farewell at first light. Yara knots the storm-ribbon into Nia's scarf, slowly, the whole goodbye played in the hands. Nia steps out with lantern, pole, and chart; the door light stays lit behind her.

panels.title: The shepherd's hearth
keyPoses: The low valley under a pushing sky. At the shepherd's hut Nia leaves half her bread and a lit spill from her own tinderbox, kindling the old woman's cold hearth. Small kindness, played wide: the hut window warms as she walks on.

panels.title: The station children
keyPoses: The gorge station: a beached ferry-boat, a boy with an oar he cannot use on cliffs, and a small girl with a bound ankle sitting very straight. Nia steps into the clearing with the lit lantern, and all three stare at the flame.

panels.title: Count the rope
keyPoses: Tested and trusted, inverted: Lumi quizzes Nia on the cliff path while Tam paces. The little girl corrects Nia's count of the rope coils, twice, and Tam's glare softens into the first almost-smile of the crossing.

panels.title: Across the gorge
keyPoses: The rope traverse over white water: Nia mid-rope with the lantern hung at her chest, Tam belaying, Lumi calling the count, and below on the far bank old Ruel the mossback hauling the spare rope with his teeth. Midway the rockfall hits, the rope jerks, and Lumi's small hands catch Nia's wrist first.

panels.title: The fever
keyPoses: Storm slope in driving sleet. Tam half-carries Lumi, whose bound ankle has gone hot with fever; her head lolls against his shoulder. Nia shields the lantern with her own cloak, and the flame leans hard away from the child.

panels.title: The choice
keyPoses: Close-up dialogue peak in the lee of a boulder: Nia opens the keeper's lantern and feeds half its flame into Lumi's shivering hands, cupped like a bird. The cairn flame gutters to a stub. Snow spirals down between their faces.

panels.title: The wind changes its mind
keyPoses: The wind changes its mind. Snow that drove into their faces all night now spirals up the slope ahead of them, marking the buried steps. Nia stares, Tam laughs once in disbelief, and they climb inside the wind's hand.

panels.title: The last steps
keyPoses: The last steps to the cairn: Tam carrying Lumi, Nia ahead with the stub cupped in both hands, all three bent double. The old brazier rim appears through the murk, black and cold, far too big for the little flame.

panels.title: Many flames
keyPoses: The cairn-top at the edge of night: Nia tips the stub into the great brazier and it nearly dies. Then below, one by one, the valley's kept sparks rise: the shepherd's window, the station lamp, door after door. The cairn takes every one and blooms.

panels.title: The valley remembers
keyPoses: Dawn wave over Ember Hollow: window after window rekindling down the hill road in a slow bloom of gold. No figures, only light answering light, the beat coming back.

panels.title: The keeper's knot
keyPoses: The keeper comes home at dawn: Yara waiting in the open door with the knotted cord, Tam steady beside the litter where Lumi sits up, awake. Yara holds out the keeper's knot without a word, and Lumi ties the final ribbon.

panels.title: Hearthlight
keyPoses: Coda on the hilltop at sunrise: Nia tending the hill-road lantern, flame high and steady, ribbons streaming true for once. Below, Tam mends the ferry-boat and Lumi charts the spring winds in charcoal. End title.
